enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Breathe. Turn to right side. Move arm. Breathe. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Breathe. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply face wash. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Dry face with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Spread butter on bread. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Eat bread. Drink milk. Stand up. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up breakfast dishes and making tea
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Carry dishes to sink. Turn on tap. Rinse dishes. Apply soap. Scrub dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Turn off tap. Pick up kettle. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on stove. Turn on stove. Wait for water to boil. Turn off stove. Pour hot water into teapot. Add tea leaves. Steep tea. Pour tea into cup. Sit at table. Drink tea. Stand up. Wash teapot. Wash cup. Place on drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the computer desk at home and checking emails and schedule, since the public transport strike means no commute today
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Walk to desk. Sit on chair. Open computer. Turn on computer. Wait for computer to start. Open email application. Check new emails. Read email 1. Read email 2. Reply to email 1. Reply to email 2. Open calendar. Check schedule. Add meeting reminder. Close calendar. Open spreadsheet. Review budget. Close spreadsheet. Open browser. Check news. Close browser. Turn on desk lamp. Adjust chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on community program planning, budget spreadsheets, and partner emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Save spreadsheet. Open email. Read partner email. Reply to partner email. Open document. Draft program plan. Save document. Open spreadsheet. Calculate budget. Update budget. Save spreadsheet. Open email. Send email to partner. Make phone call. Speak on phone. Hang up. Open document. Edit program materials. Save document. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue working.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out lettuce. Take out tomatoes. Take out cheese. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out plate. Take out knife. Place lettuce on cutting board. Cut lettuce. Cut tomatoes. Cut cheese. Place on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out dressing. Close refrigerator. Pour dressing on salad. Sit at table. Eat salad. Drink water. Stand up. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short break, stretching, and checking the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Stretch arms. Stretch legs. Stand up. Walk to window. Look outside. Walk back to sofa. Sit down. Pick up phone. Press home button. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Like post. Comment on post. Close app. Open messaging app. Read message. Reply to message. Close app. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get glass of water. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work from home: drafting program materials, scheduling meetings, and making phone calls
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open document. Draft program materials. Save document. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Send meeting invite. Open email. Check emails. Reply to email. Make phone call. Speak on phone. Take notes. Hang up. Open document. Edit program materials. Save document. Open spreadsheet. Update budget. Save spreadsheet. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Walk back to bedroom. Sit at desk. Continue working.

enriched_activities.activity: Unwinding after work and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Change channel. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out chicken. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Cut chicken. Cut vegetables. Add chicken to pan. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table.
Sit at table. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Eat food. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Continue eating. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Clear dishes. Carry dishes to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and cleaning up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Rinse dishes. Apply soap. Scrub dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Turn off tap. Wipe counter with cloth. Wipe stove. Wipe table. Sweep floor. Pick up trash. Throw trash in bin. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust pillow. Lie down on sofa. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get glass of water. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Change channel. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wait for hot water. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Rub scalp. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and browsing on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Press home button. Open browser. Browse website. Scroll. Click link. Read article. Close browser. Open social media app. Scroll. Like post. Close app. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read page. Turn page. Put down book.

enriched_activities.activity: Having a light snack and a glass of water before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out yogurt. Take out fruit. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Place yogurt in bowl. Cut fruit. Add fruit to bowl. Sit at table. Eat snack. Drink water. Stand up. Wash bowl. Wash spoon. Place on drying rack. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready for bed and sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Walk to bathroom. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Walk back to bedroom. Turn off desk lamp. Pull back blanket. Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Breathe. Turn to right side. Move arm. Breathe. Sleep.
